label: product compliance workforce process: Retrieve Vendor and Campaign Account Information — Consolidate vendor capabilities and campaign-linked customer accounts to finalize compliance and readiness approvals.

args.content:
## Landscape Summary
- 11 systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes, sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

## PRODUCT COMPLIANCE & BOM VALIDATION ⭐
- **siemens.plm:agent:BOMComplianceValidator:v1** - ⭐ EXACT FIT: Validates BOM against regulatory & engineering standards; flags non-compliant materials; recommends approved substitutes; generates compliance docs

## PROCUREMENT - PURCHASE ORDER MANAGEMENT ⭐
- **sap.ariba:apiResource:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI:v1** - ⭐ DIRECT PO EXECUTION: REST API for creating, updating, monitoring POs

## PROCUREMENT - SOURCING CAMPAIGN & ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT ⭐
- **sap.ariba:apiResource:SourceingCampaignAndAccountManagementAPI:v1** - ⭐ VENDOR & CAMPAIGN INFO CONSOLIDATION: Retrieves sourcing campaigns, customer accounts, and vendor relationship information; manages account hierarchies for compliance and readiness approvals

## PROCUREMENT WORKFORCE COMPENSATION ⭐
- **sap.ariba:apiResource:ProcurementWorkforceCompensationAPI:v1** - ⭐ WORKFORCE COMPENSATION FOR PROCUREMENT

## PROCUREMENT & MATERIAL IMPACT FOR PRODUCT TRANSITIONS
- **sap.ariba:agent:MaterialAndEngineeringChangeCoordinator:v1** - ⭐ CORE for product transition procurement impact

## PRODUCT TRANSITION & SALES COORDINATION
- **sap.crm:agent:SalesProductChangeCoordinator:v1** - Monitors engineering changes; automates notification
- **emarsys.cx:agent:ProductLifecycleOrchestrator:v1** - Monitors engineering changes; triggers coordinated customer engagement

## ANALYTICS & REPORTING FOR SERVICE TO PRODUCTION
- **corp.itsm:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1** - Generates diagnostic reports, analyzes incident patterns

## SALES COMPENSATION & PERFORMANCE
- **sap.crm:agent:SalesCompensationOrchestrator:v1** - Sales-specific compensation

## SERVICE REQUEST & ORDER CAPTURE
- **sap.s4:agent:OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine** - Converts sales opportunities to customer orders

## PRODUCTION QUALITY & YIELD ANALYSIS ⭐ NEW
- **my.mes:apiResource:EquipmentOEEAnalytics:v1** - ⭐ PRODUCTION QUALITY & YIELD: REST API for OEE data (availability, performance, quality rates); historical trend analysis; predictive insights; aggregates machine telemetry and production order execution data for performance projection
- **my.mes:agent:ProductionQualityMonitor:v1** - Real-time quality monitoring; detects deviations; monitors QualityInspection and ProductionOrder outcomes
